name: pact-community-mcp-workspace
description: Pact Community MCP servers for Kadena blockchain tooling

pact-community-shared._note: Phase 1.1 - Shared package has no server, just utilities

pact-community-pact._note: Phase 1.2a - Pact smart contract tooling complete

pact-community-chainweb._note: Phase 1.2b - Chainweb HTTP tools (info, chain_time, local, send, poll). Devnet-only. MVP 0.1.0.

pact-community-coordination._note: Phase 1.2c - Inter-agent coordination tools (10 tools: task queue, mailbox, status, memory). Full v0.1.0.

env._SMARTPACTS_DEVNET_ALLOW_LIFECYCLE: set to 'true' only when you want to allow up/down/reset
env._SMARTPACTS_DEVNET_ALLOW_VOLUME_WIPE: set to 'true' only when you want to allow `down -v` or reset (DATA LOSS)

pact-community-devnet._note: Phase 1.2d - Devnet Docker lifecycle tools (6 tools: status, health, logs, up, down, reset). Mutating tools gated by explicit env flags. v0.1.0.

playwright._note: Browser automation for visual testing. Enables WebDev/Tester/Security to drive browsers, take screenshots, test accessibility. v0.0.70.

chrome-devtools._note: Chrome DevTools integration for live DOM/CSS inspection, network analysis, console logs, performance traces. Used for diagnosing visual test failures. v0.23.0.

pact-community-deploy._note: Phase 1.3 - Module deployment and devnet management

pact-community-scan._note: Phase 1.3 - Security scanning and audit tooling
